title: Google Jules 3.0 UPDATE: FULLY FREE Async AI Coder IS INSANELY GOOD! (Jules API, Tools, CLI, & More)
summary: Feature roundup of Google Jules updates: API, CLI, repo memory, env vars, image upload, critique agent.

assertions.quote: it works asynchronously, meaning that you can move on to other tasks while it takes care of the coding

verdicts.note: Background agents do produce usable PRs for well-scoped chores, but merge rates vary widely and many PRs need iteration; 'most of the time' is optimistic.

assertions.quote: Jules memory ... it can save your preferences, corrections, and workflow habits

verdicts.note: External notes/memory files are a standard, effective pattern (Anthropic, Manus write-ups) for long tasks; adds retrieval overhead.
